MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

2. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 3
   C. 9
   D. 6

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

4. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

6. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 3

7. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 16

10. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

11. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 11

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

13. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 1
   C. 5
   D. 7

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

15. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 11
   C. 29
   D. 3

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
